summary: A seven-voice drum synth built on the LXR-02 drum machine's sound engine, as FM-1 firmware with a step sequencer and as desktop plugins (CLAP, VST3, Audio Unit) that share the same engine.
features: Three drums, snare, cymbal, and closed and open hi-hats
Seven lanes of up to 64 steps with parameter locks, chance and flam
16 patterns with their own kits, chains and a 63-row song
Kit morphing, FX bus and stereo reverb added to the engine
Loads LXR-02 .SND kits into 128 slots; no kits included
USB stereo or 10-channel audio, MIDI notes and clock in
